forms-of-governance-power.alt: Two diagrams side by side. Unitary state (example France): the national government at the top sends arrows down to three regions, which carry out national decisions. Federal state (example Germany): a constitution divides the powers between the national government (army, money) and the state governments (schools, police), so each level has its own powers. A note says both have a national government; what differs is how power is shared across space.
